items.description: The Receiving Party must keep Confidential Information in strict confidence and use it only for purposes of the Lease.
items.span_text: the Receiving Party will hold any and all Confidential Information it obtains in strictest confidence and will use and permit use of Confidential Information solely for the purposes of this Lease;

items.description: The Receiving Party must promptly notify the Disclosing Party of any actual or attempted unauthorized disclosure or use of its Confidential Information and cooperate to protect it.
items.span_text: the Receiving Party will notify the Disclosing Party of any actual or attempted unauthorized disclosure or use of the other party’s Confidential Information promptly after it becomes aware of such attempt or use

items.description: Before a legally compelled disclosure, if possible, the Receiving Party must promptly give the Disclosing Party written notice of the legal requirement.
items.span_text: promptly after becoming aware of such law, order, or requirement and, if possible, prior to disclosing Confidential Information pursuant thereto, the Receiving Party will so notify the Disclosing Party in writing.
items.trigger: To the extent required by Applicable Law or by lawful order or requirement of a court or governmental authority having competent jurisdiction over the Receiving Party

items.description: The Receiving Party must use reasonable efforts to withhold Confidential Information while the Disclosing Party contests or limits a compelled disclosure.
items.span_text: The Receiving Party will use reasonable efforts not to release Confidential Information pending the outcome of any measures taken by the Disclosing Party to contest, otherwise oppose, or seek to limit such disclosure by the Receiving Party

items.description: On written request or on expiration or termination of the Lease, the Receiving Party must return or destroy, at the Disclosing Party's option, tangible documents containing the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.
items.span_text: the Receiving Party will, promptly after written request from the Disclosing Party, with respect to either Landlord or Tenant, as the case may be, return or destroy, at the Disclosing Party’s option, all tangible
items.trigger: On the Disclosing Party’s written request or upon expiration or termination of this Lease for any reason
